description: This file contains React component tests for the Board component, verifying accessibility attributes, ARIA roles and labels, and keyboard interactions within a Tic-Tac-Toe game frontend.

methods.name: test('Board renders 9 squares with ARIA roles and labels')
methods.description: Verifies that the Board component renders 9 grid cells with appropriate ARIA roles and labels, ensuring accessibility features are correctly implemented.

methods.name: test('Keyboard interaction triggers onSquareClick')
methods.description: Ensures that pressing Enter and Space keys on grid cells correctly triggers the onSquareClick callback with the respective index.
